classification.difficultyReason: Requires constructing an axial section and recognising the difference of the two radii as the horizontal leg before applying Pythagoras to find the perpendicular height.

content.prompt: A bobbin for an industrial knitting machine is in the shape of a truncated cone. The diameter of the top is 4 cm, the diameter of the base is 6 cm and the length of the slant is 10 cm. Find the height of the bobbin, correct to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Upright unshaded truncated cone with a complete elliptical top, two sloping silhouettes and the visible front arc of the lower rim. Source decorative blue outlines are rendered in house black.
spec.mathematics: Top diameter 4 cm, bottom diameter 6 cm and right slant length 10 cm; perpendicular height is not supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; no height, radius difference or solution construction is shown.

answer.worked:
The top and base radii are $2$ cm and $3$ cm. An axial section gives a right-angled triangle with horizontal side $3-2=1$ cm, hypotenuse $10$ cm and perpendicular height $h$ cm.

$$\begin{align*}h^2+1^2&=10^2\\h^2&=100-1\\h^2&=99\\h&=\sqrt{99}\\h&\approx9.95\end{align*}$$

The height is $9.95\text{ cm}$, correct to 2 decimal places.
